systems.platform: DHIS2-Ed, open source, on the DHIS2 platform
systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Regional Education Bureaus, with technical assistance from UNICEF, the HISP Centre (University of Oslo) and HISP Ethiopia
systems.tiers: the project works with schools, woreda education offices and zonal education departments in the SER, SWEPR, Oromia and Benishangul-Gumuz regions, from November 2025

note: The article states an aim to put the ministry's education information system to work at woreda education offices in four regions; it does not say any woreda office is connected or works in the system online, and gives no count of offices.
